document.title: StickerDB Input Replay Satellite Communication Protocol SoftSpec v2
document.purpose: Describe the current JSON request and response protocol used between StickerDB and Input Replay Satellite, including image printing through IrfanView and InputLog.
author: Lion Kimbro
Codex

overview.description: StickerDB requests a job by copying JSON into the satellite inbox. The request retains absolute paths to requester-owned inputs, outputs, and response callback. Input Replay Satellite runs a request only after an operator explicitly launches the queue, then writes one response JSON file to response_path.
overview.style: SoftSpec: descriptive over rigid validation. This document names the current implemented job vocabulary and the meanings of its request and response fields.
overview.versioning: This document supersedes the v1 protocol document as the implementation-current job vocabulary. The request and response schema string remains *.v1 because the wire structure is compatible; this document version does not require a schema-string change.
ownership: StickerDB owns requester-side job cells and their cleanup.
The satellite may read named requester inputs and write only named outputs and response_path.
The satellite must not delete requester-owned inputs, outputs, response files, or job-cell directories.

transport-and-lifecycle.submission: Copy one request JSON file into the satellite-owned inbox.
transport-and-lifecycle.execution: Human-gated. A pending request does not itself authorize GUI automation.
transport-and-lifecycle.request-identity: job_id is stable across retries and uniquely identifies one requester job.
transport-and-lifecycle.expiration: The satellite rejects a request whose expires_at has passed before it begins.
transport-and-lifecycle.response: The satellite atomically writes one terminal response JSON object to response_path.
transport-and-lifecycle.additional-request-keys: Tolerated unless a future protocol revision documents different behavior.

inputlog-integration.working-directory: C:/lion/installed/inputlog by default, configurable as execpath.inputlog-root.
inputlog-integration.completion-rule: The satellite waits for InputLog to exit and requires a readable, current report for the expected recording. Only completion-status normal is a normal automation outcome.
inputlog-integration.physical-print-caution: A normal InputLog result proves only that the recording reached its end. It does not independently prove printer operation, print quality, or physical output.

layout_sticker_to_lds.description: Given a sticker image, create an LDS file through Leonardo Design Studio.

print_lds_file.description: Given an LDS file, print it through Leonardo Design Studio using InputLog automation.

infranview_print_x1.description: Given an image file, stage it in the Launch folder and use the IrfanView x1 InputLog recording to print it. The recording uses the printer defaults active when playback begins.
operator-preflight: IrfanView is open and ready for the recorded sequence.
The printer is on and loaded with paper.
Make sure the printer defaults are presently set to the document size you want.
The dedicated Launch folder is blank at the instant the operator starts the queue.
infranview_print_x1.success-observation: InputLog completed the IrfanView x1 print recording normally. This does not independently prove physical print quality.

infranview_print_x2.description: Given an image file, stage it in the Launch folder and use the IrfanView x2 InputLog recording to print it. The recording uses the printer defaults active when playback begins.
operator-preflight: IrfanView is open and ready for the recorded sequence.
The printer is on and loaded with paper.
Make sure the printer defaults are presently set to the document size you want.
The dedicated Launch folder is blank at the instant the operator starts the queue.
infranview_print_x2.success-observation: InputLog completed the IrfanView x2 print recording normally. This does not independently prove physical print quality.

rules: job_id and job must be non-empty strings.
created_at and expires_at must be timezone-aware timestamps, and expires_at must be later than created_at.
input and output, when present, must be JSON objects.
Every input path, output path, and response_path must be an absolute path.
Requests should be treated as immutable after submission.

layout_sticker_to_lds.sticker_image_path: Absolute path to the requester-owned sticker image.

print_lds_file.lds_file_path: Absolute path to the requester-owned LDS file to print.

infranview_print_x1.image_path: Absolute path to the requester-owned image file. The satellite copies this file, retaining its filename, into the dedicated Launch folder for this attempt.

infranview_print_x2.image_path: Absolute path to the requester-owned image file. The satellite copies this file, retaining its filename, into the dedicated Launch folder for this attempt.

layout_sticker_to_lds.lds_file_path: Absolute path where the satellite must leave the generated LDS file.

terminal-statuses.done: The satellite observed a normal automation outcome and completed any defined output collection.
terminal-statuses.interrupted: InputLog observed physical user input that stopped playback, and the operator chose a terminal disposition.
terminal-statuses.failed: The request, staging, InputLog playback, completion report, or output collection failed.
terminal-statuses.expired: The request was past expires_at before it was run.

response-contract.print-job-observation: For print_lds_file, infranview_print_x1, and infranview_print_x2, a done response reports normal automation completion only. It does not assert physical printing, print quantity, printer state, or print quality.

infranview-print-x2-success-response.message: InputLog completed the IrfanView x2 print recording normally.
observations: InputLog completion-status was normal at stage complete.
The satellite does not independently verify physical print quality.
